name: Tosylchloramide
description: Tosylchloramide (CAS 144-86-5 ), commercially recognized as Chloramine-T, is an active chlorine-releasing compound used as a biocide, disinfectant, and bleaching agent across industrial and institutional applications. It delivers controlled oxidative action, making it suitable for processes where precise antimicrobial performance is required without the handling challenges of elemental chlorine. In water treatment, it is used to disinfect potable water. It is also applied in cooling systems and process water where stable chlorine release over time is preferred to hypochlorite. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as a reagent for radiolabeling proteins and peptides. This is particularly critical in iodination procedures for diagnostic compound production. In industrial and institutional cleaning, it is formulated into sanitizers and disinfectants for food-contact surface treatment. It is also utilized for healthcare facility hygiene and veterinary disinfection. Textile and paper processors apply it as a bleaching agent where controlled whitening without fiber degradation is a requirement. Tosylchloramide is supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder or granules. It is available in technical grade for industrial disinfection and cleaning applications for various global markets. The material is also available as pharmaceutical-grade material meeting USP and BP specifications for regulated manufacturing. Active chlorine content is a key specification buyers should confirm. This specification directly affects dosing and product performance in final formulations.
